The 18 entities are 3 browser engines, 8 bridge primitives and 7 interaction barriers. Canonical glossary terms live in CONTEXT.md.

Sources & Claims (UKMC.v2): 40 captured items -> 27 source objects -> 32 quoted claims across 6 documents, independently reviewed in _evidence/agent-browser-extensions-261116/review.json. Never hand-edit claims/, sources/, captures.jsonl, or index.json.

Engine & Adapter (v0.3.0): Shared TypeScript >= 7.0.2 RPC contracts (shared/), Chromium & Firefox MV3 extension builds (extension/), 127.0.0.1:4347 broker + node:sqlite + CLI + 22-tool MCP (cli/), and es:skill-forge v2 tool-product package (skills/es-browser-agent/, workflows/, bundles/).
knowledge/agent-browser-extensions/ Verified UKMC.v2 pack (ontology.yaml, 6 docs, 32 claims, 27 sources, 18 entities, index.json, _evidence/)
shared/ Shared TypeScript >= 7.0.2 Agent RPC envelope, capability tier, native 32-bit framing, LinkedIn schemas
extension/ Chromium & Firefox MV3 builds, Page Epoch store, Operate popup, MAIN 429/451 sentinel, LinkedIn ARIA adapter
cli/ 127.0.0.1:4347 WebSocket broker, node:sqlite cache, browser-agent CLI (--json), 22-tool MCP stdio server
skills/es-browser-agent/ Tool-product skill (SKILL.md, concepts.md, rules.md, look.md, contract.md, build/validate/look scripts)
workflows/ & commands/ Agent playbooks (LinkedIn workflow, New Site workflow, /doctor, /linkedin)
bundles/ Synced portable bundles for claude-code, codex, gemini, and grok-build
tests/ 17 Vitest suites covering fencing, Human Gate Handoff, normalizer, SQLite/MCP, manifests, A1–A9 skill gates, and Shared Browser Layer (#8–#26)
scripts/ build.mjs, e2e_visual_proof.mjs, skill_contract.mjs, sync_host_bundles.mjs, self_check.py, verify_bridge_primitives.py

Tier-3 Safari Web Extension still requires a native macOS/iOS Xcode App Container wrapper (SafariWebExtensionHandler host binary), documented in cross-browser-capability-matrix.md and not packaged as an .app bundle yet.
The knowledge pack's stopping gate (pack check) sits at DEEPEN (0/3 low-delta rounds): treat the research corpus as an extensible living pack alongside the v0.3.0 runtime.

Live LinkedIn testing operates strictly inside the user's authenticated browser session; fixture E2E runs (npm run test:e2e) cover deterministic Chromium MV3 attachment, ARIA reads of SDUI-shaped fixture pages, safe prefill, and BLOCKED_CHALLENGE halt without hitting live production accounts.
Browser Extension is one of the DESIGN:OS tools. The others: Studio, CLI, Bridge, SVG Animation, 3D Blender, Knowledge Builder and mcp-bridge-go. More on jangtrinh.github.io.
